status: frozen before any Stage67 arm was fitted, simulated or scored

flags.source: frozen 2026-10-06 read-only historical audit (exceptional ex-ante uncertainty at the voting-open cutoff); human judgement, not a fitted feature

fromResidualRankedList.meaning: primary flags that also appeared in the residual-ranked list (>= 0.5 sigma) shown to the auditor; disclosed bias

flags.sensitivity: primary minus fromResidualRankedList (17 flags); the 21 list-derived flags count as ordinary in fit and score

free.multiplier: Stage60 free arm, data/processed/balance-shrink/fit.json folds.<year>.multipliers.free, unchanged

twogroup.multiplier: exp(a) ordinary, exp(a + b) primary-flagged; a, b earlier-trained, penalty-free

twogroup17.multiplier: as twogroup with the 17-flag sensitivity set; never recommendable

twogroup_exc1.multiplier: exp(a) ordinary, 1.00 (frozen scale) primary-flagged; a earlier-trained, penalty-free

fit.objective: Stage48 per-seat-normalised Gaussian negative log likelihood, equal environments and equal seats; features (flag, 0); b_T = 0

components.representativeSeats: first, middle and last seat of each election

decision.comparison: each candidate arm (twogroup, twogroup_exc1) versus free on the 193 decision seats; then twogroup versus twogroup_exc1

groupCoverageFloors.rule: twogroup coverage >= min(nominal - nominalMargin, free coverage - alreadyUndercoveringMargin) on the group's N/L candidate coordinates

bootstrap.scheme: seats resampled with replacement within election, pooled equal-seat mean, paired

decision.sensitivityStatement: flag_selection_sensitive if twogroup17 pooled dCRPS vs free is >= 0 while twogroup's is < 0; reported, never changes the finding
decision.selection: both qualify: twogroup only if it Stage48-IMPROVES on twogroup_exc1, else twogroup_exc1; one qualifies: that arm; none: floor_blocked if either IMPROVES vs free, negligible if both NEGLIGIBLE, worse if both WORSE, else mixed

doNot: no arm beyond control, free, twogroup, twogroup_exc1 and twogroup17; no grid, penalty, prior-strength or feature search
no flag added, removed or reclassified after any Stage67 fit or score
no mean, location, S, R, shared-scale, local-party or national change; no composed bank, national MCMC, acquisition, source or data/sources.json edit
no change to frozen Stage45/46/47/48/60 outputs, scales, draw counts, gates or tolerances
no CI, workflow or validation-registry edit
no operational adoption; no calibrated-probability or seat-win claim

descriptive.twogroup17GroupReport: ordinary and exceptional (17-flag) coverage, width and CRPS by election, reported beside the rule
descriptive.leak: scored seats were flagged with results known; ordinary narrowing is partly mechanical (coordinator estimate about 0.72 from trimming alone)

amendments.change: add twogroup_exc1, revised selection, twogroup17 group report, named leak, decision numbers D101/D102
amendments.timing: after the original arms were fitted (multipliers seen), before any score was read; one unread evaluation bank deleted and regenerated
